as_told.title: Roger Leir's book: Humanitas doctors' contact with a being

plain: James Fox, a filmmaker who investigates UFO cases, told podcast host Jesse Michels about a 1996 case in Varginha, a town in Brazil, where some say a live alien creature was captured. Fox points to tapes and a book by a researcher named Roger Leir, who, he says, describes meeting two doctors at a hospital. According to Fox, the doctors talked about a creature there and about communicating with it by telepathy, mind to mind, which would mean doctors had direct contact with a living alien if true. In a later conversation he names the place as Humanitas Hospital and says this part is in Leir's book but not on the tapes.
